steps.instruction: Soak the lima beans in water overnight.
steps.spoken: Soak the lima beans in water overnight, or at least six hours. Change the water 2 to 3 times.

steps.instruction: Boil the beans in enough water to cover them, with no salt.
steps.spoken: Boil the beans without salt in enough water to cover them. Use high heat until the water boils.

steps.instruction: Skim the foam from the water.
Simmer the beans for about 1 hour.
steps.spoken: Simmer the beans for about 1 hour. The time depends on how dry the beans were, so keep going until they are plump and tender.

steps.instruction: Take the beans off the heat and drain them when plump and tender.
steps.spoken: When the beans are plump and tender, take them off the heat and drain them. You can save the cooking liquid to turn leftovers into a soup.

steps.instruction: Season the beans lightly with salt.
Mix 1 cup olive oil, 2 to 3 teaspoons white vinegar and 1 tablespoon Dijon mustard.
Add 1 diced red onion and 2 seeded, diced tomatoes.
Season the vinaigrette with salt and pepper to taste.
When the beans are at room temperature, taste the vinaigrette.
steps.spoken: Once the beans are at room temperature, taste the vinaigrette and adjust the seasoning. It should taste a bit stronger than you expect.

steps.instruction: Carefully mix the vinaigrette with the beans.
Mix in a few sprigs of parsley.
